summary_en: A tiny alley of standing bars behind the station, best after 7 p.m.
description_en: A fictional backstreet to show how hidden-gem listings look: a narrow lane of counters with six or eight seats each, where the person next to you is usually a regular.
Point at what others are eating, say kanpai, and you'll fit right in.
highlights_en: Standing bars with a handful of seats
access_en: A few minutes from the station's west side.
image_alt: Illustration of a narrow alley lit by two paper lanterns at night
